title: KitBag manifest (kitbag.toml)
description: Schema versions 1 and 2 of the manifest a configuration repository commits as kitbag.toml; kitbag.v1.schema.json describes schema 1 alone. Schema 2 adds a hosts filter on instances and makes host instance tables patches. The manifest declares intent only: which repository files become which agent primitives, on which hosts and instances. Resolved pins live in the separately versioned provenance contract; destination paths, applied hashes and ownership live in machine-local state. See docs/manifest.md.

schema.description: Manifest schema version. A tool that knows version N reads N and N-1 and rejects everything else.

min_tool_version.description: Lowest kitbag release allowed to apply this manifest (semantic version). An older tool stops before planning.

mode.description: Manifest-wide materialization mode. Unset leaves the choice to the machine (config.toml, --mode, platform default).

commands.description: Reusable prompt or slash-command files, kept in each agent's native format.

agents.description: Subagent definition files, kept in each agent's native format.

hooks.description: Hook definition and script files. Hooks that live inside an agent's settings file are part of the target's settings fragment instead.

rules.description: Rule or memory files, kept in each agent's native format.

files.description: Arbitrary repository files placed at home-relative destinations.

targets.description: Agents that receive the primitives, keyed by a target name of your choice.

hosts.description: Per-host overrides, keyed by the host name from config.toml (default: the machine's short host name).

mode.description: link creates symlinks to the working copy; copy writes files and tracks drift. copy always wins over link when any applicable layer requests it.

agentKind.description: Agent adapter kind. copilot is the ~/.copilot home contract shared by Copilot CLI and the VS Code Copilot harness; other surfaces use generic with explicit roots.

name.description: Identifier for targets, instances, servers and imports: lowercase letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; must start with a letter or digit.

repoPath.description: Path relative to the repository root using '/'; no leading '/', '~' or '$', no '.' or '..' segments, no backslashes, no trailing '/'.

homePath.description: Destination path that starts with '~/' (the user's home directory on the applying machine); no '.' or '..' segments, no backslashes, no trailing '/'. Absolute paths are not allowed.

hostTemplate.description: Repository path template containing the literal placeholder {host}.

perAgentFiles.description: Repository paths keyed by agent kind.

collection.description: A set of files for one primitive: a shared directory applied wherever the format is native, plus per-agent directories that win on name collisions.

dir.description: Shared source directory. Each entry is applied to every enabled target whose adapter declares the entry's format native; otherwise the plan reports it as unsupported.

per_agent.description: Source directories for one agent kind only. Entries are added to that kind's set and replace same-name entries from dir.

instructions.description: Always-loaded global instructions: one shared source, optional per-host additions and optional per-agent replacement files.

hosts.description: Template of the per-host additions file, for example hosts/{host}.md. A missing file for the current host is reported and skipped.

per_agent.description: Replacement for source for one agent kind (the dotagents pattern). Host additions still apply.

skills.description: Skill directories (each child directory holding SKILL.md is one skill) and import intent.

dirs.description: Directories whose child directories are skills. Skill names must be unique across all of them.

interchange.description: A skills CLI skills-lock.json (version 1) that kitbag may read and export as an explicitly bounded subset. It is not kitbag's provenance record and never sufficient for frozen installation.

imports.description: Where vendored skills come from (intent only). Resolved commits and hashes belong to the provenance contract, never here.

source.description: Source repository: GitHub shorthand owner/repo, an https:// or ssh:// URL, or git@host:path. No whitespace.

path.description: Directory of the skill inside the source repository. Default: the repository root.

ref.description: Requested selector (branch or tag). It is intent; the resolved commit is recorded by the provenance contract.

dir.description: Which entry of skills.dirs holds the vendored copy. Default: the first entry.

mcp.description: MCP servers defined once and rendered into each supporting agent's native format.

policy.description: merge keeps servers the manifest does not mention and overwrites same-name servers; replace makes the native server set equal to the manifest. Removal of kitbag-owned servers is driven by local state. Default: merge.

transport.description: stdio (default when command is set), http or sse (require url).

env.description: Literal environment variables. Secrets are not allowed here; name them in secret_env instead.

headers.description: Literal request headers. Secrets are not allowed here.

secret_env.description: Environment variables the server needs whose values must come from the machine, never from the repository.

agents.description: Restrict rendering to these agent kinds. Default: every enabled target whose adapter supports MCP.

hosts.description: Apply only on these hosts. Default: every host.

include.description: Git configuration files added as include.path entries of the user's global Git configuration.

primitives.description: Per-primitive switches for one target or instance. Unset primitives are applied wherever the adapter supports them.

render.description: import writes a file that imports the sources with the agent's native import syntax; concat writes the concatenated content. Default: the adapter's documented default.

instances.description: Configuration directories of one agent, keyed by an instance name.

dir.description: The agent's configuration directory itself (for example ~/.claude_2), never a relocation variable.

settings.description: Whether the target's settings fragment is merged into this instance. false corresponds to today's settings=off.

roots.description: Per-primitive destination roots that replace the adapter's documented default for this instance. Required for generic.

settings.description: Native settings fragment merged into every instance that has settings enabled, with the documented merge rules.

instances.description: Default instances on every host. Omitted: the adapter's single documented default directory.

then.description: generic has no adapter knowledge: every instance must declare its roots and settings merging is unavailable.

instances.description: Schema 1: replaces the target's instance set on this host.

instancesV2.description: Schema 2: configuration directories of one agent, keyed by an instance name; each may be limited to hosts.

dir.description: The agent's configuration directory itself (for example ~/.claude_2), never a relocation variable.

hosts.description: Use this instance only on these hosts. Default: every host. On other hosts it is inactive, and the target still does not fall back to its implicit default.

settings.description: Whether the target's settings fragment is merged into this instance. false corresponds to today's settings=off.

roots.description: Per-primitive destination roots that replace the adapter's documented default for this instance. Required for generic.

settings.description: Native settings fragment merged into every instance that has settings enabled, with the documented merge rules.

instances.description: Instances, each on every host unless its hosts key limits it. Omitted: the adapter's single documented default directory.

then.description: generic has no adapter knowledge: every instance must declare its roots and settings merging is unavailable.

instancePatch.description: Schema 2: changes enabled, mode or settings of the target's instance of the same name on this host. It never declares an instance: dir, roots, primitives and hosts belong on the target's instance.

instances.description: Patches the target's instances on this host, by name; each name must be declared on the target and active on this host.

publish.description: How kitbag push publishes local changes: direct pushes to branch; pr pushes a kitbag/{host}/{slug} branch and opens a pull request.

branch.description: Branch that receives changes. Default: the remote's default branch.
